title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks lack direction as traders assess Middle East conflict
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：交易员评估中东冲突，股市缺乏方向
summary: Conflicting advice over whether US-Iran truce talks have occurred leaves traders confused
summary_zh: 关于美伊休战谈判是否已经进行的相互矛盾的建议让交易员感到困惑

title: Exclusive-Amazon says AWS' Bahrain region 'disrupted' following drone activity
title_zh: 亚马逊称 AWS 巴林地区因无人机活动而“受到干扰”
summary: By Greg Bensinger SAN FRANCISCO, March 23 (Reuters) - Amazon said on Monday its Amazon Web Services region in Bahrain has been "disrupted" amid the current conflict in the Middle East.
summary_zh: 路透旧金山 3 月 23 日 - 亚马逊周一表示，其位于巴林的亚马逊网络服务区域因当前中东冲突而受到“干扰”。

title: European car sales rise modestly in February, Tesla reverses year-long skid
title_zh: 欧洲2月汽车销量小幅增长 特斯拉扭转全年下滑
summary: By Alessandro Parodi March 24 (Reuters) - New car sales in Europe rose in February after falling in January, while sustained demand for electric vehicles helped Elon Musk's all-electric brand Tesla
summary_zh: 路透 3 月 24 日 - 欧洲新车销量继 1 月份下降后，2 月份出现增长，而电动汽车的持续需求帮助埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下的全电动品牌特斯拉 (Tesla)

title: Meta Hires Former Google, Stripe Executives Behind AI Startup Dreamer
title_zh: Meta 聘请前谷歌和 Stripe 高管，打造 AI 初创公司 Dreamer
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. has hired the founders and team behind the artificial intelligence startup Dreamer, which launched earlier this year to help people create their own AI agents.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Meta Platforms Inc. 聘请了人工智能初创公司 Dreamer 的创始人和团队，该公司于今年早些时候推出，旨在帮助人们创建自己的人工智能代理。

title: US stocks jump after Trump delays strikes on Iran's power plants
title_zh: 特朗普推迟对伊朗发电厂的打击后，美国股市上涨

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures waver as Iran officials reject negotiation
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因伊朗官员拒绝谈判而波动
summary: The US-Israeli war in Iran is dominating market discussion as hopeful news emerges of hostilities winding down.
summary_zh: 随着敌对行动结束的充满希望的消息出现，美以在伊朗的战争成为市场讨论的焦点。

title: Stocks Rise, Oil Falls as Trump Eases Iran Threats: Markets Wrap
title_zh: 特朗普缓解伊朗威胁，股市上涨，油价下跌：市场休整
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A possible de-escalation in the Middle East conflict rippled through markets, with oil falling and stocks rising as President Donald Trump said he’d postpone strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure after what he described as productive talks toward ending hosti...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——中东冲突可能缓和，这波及整个市场，油价下跌，股市上涨，因为唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，在结束敌对局势的富有成效的谈判后，他将推迟对伊朗能源基础设施的袭击。

title: JPMorgan offers clients a new way to hedge AI debt risk
title_zh: 摩根大通为客户提供一种对冲人工智能债务风险的新方法

title: F1 CEO talks US growth as business accelerates
title_zh: F1 首席执行官谈论美国业务加速增长
summary: Formula One (F1) CEO Stefano Domenicali joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss F1's rapid growth in the US market, new racing regulations, and more. Watch the video above to hear more on the sport's focus on expansion and entertainment.
summary_zh: 一级方程式 (F1) 首席执行官 Stefano Domenicali 与雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 一起讨论 F1 在美国市场的快速增长、新的赛车法规等。观看上面的视频，了解更多关于这项运动对扩展和娱乐的关注。
